title: Classical Bits & Digital Logic
summary: Binary switch states (0 or 1), macroscopic voltages, and Boolean operations.

title: Qubits & Quantum Superposition
summary: State vectors as linear combinations: |ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ with normalization |α|² + |β|² = 1.

title: Dirac Bra-Ket Notation & Statevectors
summary: Column vectors |ψ⟩ (kets), conjugate duals ⟨ψ| (bras), and inner products ⟨φ|ψ⟩.

title: 3D Bloch Sphere Geometry
summary: Mapping pure single-qubit states to angles (θ, φ) on the unit sphere S²: |ψ⟩ = cos(θ/2)|0⟩ + e^(iφ)sin(θ/2)|1⟩.

title: Born Rule & Projective Measurement
summary: Measurement collapse onto eigenstates |0⟩ and |1⟩ with probability P(x) = |⟨x|ψ⟩|².

title: Pauli-X Gate (Bit-Flip & NOT)
summary: π rotation around the Bloch X-axis: X|0⟩ = |1⟩, X|1⟩ = |0⟩.

title: Pauli-Z Gate (Phase-Flip)
summary: π rotation around the Bloch Z-axis: Z|0⟩ = |0⟩, Z|1⟩ = -|1⟩.

title: Pauli-Y Gate (Complex Phase Flip)
summary: π rotation around the Bloch Y-axis: Y|0⟩ = i|1⟩, Y|1⟩ = -i|0⟩.

title: Hadamard Gate (Basis Rotation)
summary: Transforms computational basis to superposition basis: H|0⟩ = |+⟩, H|1⟩ = |-⟩.

title: Phase Rotations (S, T, Rz)
summary: Z-axis rotations: S (π/2 phase) and T (π/4 phase) gates adding relative phase shifts.

title: Global vs. Relative Phase
summary: Why e^(iθ)|ψ⟩ is physically undetectable while |0⟩ + e^(iθ)|1⟩ alters interference.

title: Tensor Products & Composite Systems
summary: Kronecker product construction: 2^n dimensional Hilbert space for n qubits.

title: Multi-Qubit Computational Basis
summary: Representing product states |00⟩, |01⟩, |10⟩, |11⟩ and 4-amplitude statevectors.

title: Controlled-NOT (CX) Gate
summary: Two-qubit conditional bit flip: CX|c, t⟩ = |c, c ⊕ t⟩. Fundamental entangling gate.

title: Controlled Phase (CZ) & SWAP Gates
summary: Symmetric two-qubit CZ gate (|11⟩ ➔ -|11⟩) and state interchange via 3 CNOTs.

title: Bell States & Maximal Entanglement
summary: The 4 maximally entangled orthonormal EPR pairs: |Φ±⟩ = (|00⟩ ± |11⟩)/√2, |Ψ±⟩ = (|01⟩ ± |10⟩)/√2.

title: Density Operator & Mixed States
summary: Ensemble formalism: ρ = Σ p_i |ψ_i⟩⟨ψ_i|. Distinguishing pure (Tr(ρ²)=1) vs mixed states (Tr(ρ²)<1).

title: Partial Trace & Subsystem Purity
summary: Computing reduced state ρ_A = Tr_B(ρ). Entanglement causes subsystem purity to drop below 1 (r < 0.95).

title: Multi-Party Entangled States (GHZ & W)
summary: 3-qubit entanglement: GHZ (|000⟩+|111⟩)/√2 (fragile) vs W (|001⟩+|010⟩+|100⟩)/√3 (robust).

title: No-Cloning Theorem
summary: Proof that no unitary operator U exists such that U|ψ⟩|0⟩ = |ψ⟩|ψ⟩ for all arbitrary |ψ⟩.

title: Quantum Interference
summary: Constructive addition and destructive cancellation of complex probability amplitudes.

title: Phase Kickback Mechanism
summary: Eigenvalue e^(iθ) of a target state |-⟩ kicks back into the control qubit: U|x⟩|-⟩ = (-1)^(f(x))|x⟩|-⟩.

title: Deutsch's Algorithm
summary: Determines if f: {0,1} ➔ {0,1} is constant or balanced in 1 query using phase kickback.

title: Deutsch-Jozsa Algorithm
summary: Exponential quantum speedup determining if n-bit function is constant or balanced in a single evaluation.

title: Bernstein-Vazirani Algorithm
summary: Finds hidden n-bit string s where f(x) = s · x in exactly 1 quantum query vs n classical queries.

title: Simon's Algorithm (Periodicity)
summary: Exponential speedup finding hidden period s where f(x ⊕ s) = f(x); inspired Shor's factoring algorithm.

title: Grover Oracle (Phase Inversion)
summary: Flips the phase of the marked search target state: O|x⟩ = (-1)^f(x)|x⟩.

title: Grover Diffusion Operator
summary: Inversion about the mean: D = 2|s⟩⟨s| - I. Amplifies marked item probability to ~100% in O(√N) steps.

title: Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT)
summary: Quantum analog of Discrete Fourier Transform using Hadamard and controlled phase rotations.

title: NISQ Noise & Hardware Realities
summary: Decoherence (T1/T2 relaxation), gate infidelities, depolarizing noise channels, and error mitigation.
